dedupe_keys.name: int tunisia telecommunications observatory monthly quarterly and qos reports

description: The observatory of Tunisia's telecommunications regulator, the Instance Nationale des Télécommunications (INT), publishes market indicators for fixed telephony, mobile telephony and internet. The observatory page read on 2026-09-29 lists monthly reports for fixed telephony, mobile telephony, fixed data and mobile data (for example the March 2025 mobile and data tables), monthly key-figure reports since the 5G launch (September 2025 to July 2026), quarterly, half-yearly and annual reports, reports on the effect of the COVID-19 lockdown, and quality-of-service reports on fixed internet (for example the ADSL quality syntheses for the first two quarters of 2024). The July 2026 key-figures report gives subscriber counts for fixed wireless access, average monthly data use per subscription and mobile data activations and revenues by month. Coverage: national, Tunisia, operator-level and market totals. Format and access: free PDF reports on intt.tn, with a separate portal for fixed and mobile internet quality measurements. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the INT states that the figures are supplied by the operators and may be revised; tables sit inside PDFs, not in machine-readable files; the old address int.tn no longer answers. Simulation uses: demand and subscriber baselines for telecom network models and service performance inputs for resilience studies of mobile and internet access. Related records: compare with the telecom observatories of Benin (data-arcep-benin-telecom-observatory-and-qos) and Chad (data-arcep-tchad-telecom-observatory).
